name: vmr_l2straight_l3wp
scope: G4-STRICT plan + AS-BUILT re-timing; PLAN MODEL, UNCHECKED

model.form: uf_asbuilt (sum-of-branch loads, Elmore per branch, leaf MST) + rise/fall chains; NLDM + setRC 0.8/0.9
model.offset_basis: MODEL-REFIT 930fa9628d avg form (btab R5, one point); applied unchanged to early/late
model.unabsorbed_residual: prog as-built residual TT -16.6 sd3.6 / FF -11.8 sd2.9 (KITS-2 r2) NOT applied
model.waypoint_rule: legal cell w with d(a,w)+d(w,b)=T; key = (legs unbalanced >25% T, path cells in pin-escape bands [order swapped with --wp-key conf], |d(a,w)-d(w,b)|, distance to edge midpoint)

entry_trunk.run: N-S in the centre gap from the entry island
entry_trunk.objective: min max(|TT avg mean-250|, |FF early mean-202.5|), offsets applied; 12.8c/d1 plan-computed
